description: This Java abstract class 'BaseConceptMap' serves as a superclass for concept mapping entities within the OpenMRS project. It manages common properties such as concept map type, creator, changer, and timestamps for creation and modification, and provides getter and setter methods for these fields.

classes.name: BaseConceptMap
classes.description: An abstract superclass for concept mapping classes, providing common properties like concept map type, creator, changer, and timestamps.
